evidenceLevels.claim: The website is publicly accessible to permitted crawlers.
Named crawlers have accessed discovery files or content pages, and public archives expose historical captures.

commonCrawlIndexObservation.meaning: Both selected indexes returned usable responses with zero observed captures. This complete result covers only the selected indexes and must not be interpreted as proof of zero captures across all Common Crawl history.

fixedPromptArchiveCoverage.meaning: This maps public historical Wayback captures to the fixed prompt matrix: 15 of 20 unique evidence pages have captures, 15 prompts have at least one archived evidence page, and 12 prompts have every mapped evidence page archived. It does not prove search indexing, AI retrieval, citation, ranking, endorsement, or recommendation.

waybackArchiveObservation.meaning: The public Wayback CDX host query returned 93 successful HTML capture records across 43 distinct URLs. These records prove public historical captures only; they do not prove current accessibility, search indexing, AI retrieval, citation, ranking, endorsement, or recommendation. An unavailable future query must not be interpreted as zero captures.

limitations: The corrected path classifier newly recognized three homepage requests and ten machine-resource requests that occurred on 2026-09-09 and 2026-09-10; this is historical reclassification, not new crawler activity.
GPTBot is a training crawler and does not prove ChatGPT Search indexing or citation.

Baiduspider and YandexBot use their providers’ official reverse-DNS suffixes plus forward confirmation; Applebot uses the official published CIDR list. Verified YandexBot crawling proves access by that search crawler, not public indexing, ranking, AI retrieval, or citation.

AhrefsBot uses the official Ahrefs published CIDR list. Because it serves both Ahrefs and Yep, verified discovery-file requests do not prove Yep indexing, ranking, retrieval, citation, or AI recommendation and are excluded from fixed-prompt search coverage.
Bytespider candidates are labeled user-agent-only and identity-unverified; they do not prove Doubao or ByteDance access.

The synthetic crawler exclusion count is published as a monotonic minimum because live gates create more marked checks; it is audit context across all crawler families and is intentionally not treated as visibility evidence or an exact drift trigger.
Common Crawl index observations cover only the named selected indexes; they do not prove search indexing, retrieval, citation, or absence across all crawl history.
Wayback CDX records prove public historical captures only; they do not prove current accessibility, search indexing, AI retrieval, citation, ranking, endorsement, or recommendation.
Discovery-file visits do not prove content-page ingestion.
Bingbot content crawls do not prove public search indexing.
Prompt-level crawl coverage does not prove prompt retrieval, citation, ranking, or recommendation.

lowConfidenceEntityDirectoryResults.treatment: Search-result evidence only. The page is unclaimed, says its data comes from the internet without guarantee, omits the registration number and address, and contains a conflicting industry classification; it is not accepted as an authoritative entity source or linked with sameAs.

publicSearchObservation.entityRecordMeaning: These records make the legal entity externally discoverable and disambiguatable. They do not prove official-site indexing, website ownership, service verification, endorsement, AI citation, or recommendation.

evidenceLevels.nullMeaning: A null AI-answer observation means the controlled platform test has not been run; it is not a negative answer result.

evidenceLevels.claim: No qualifying non-brand AI recommendation has been preserved.
limitations: High-velocity or coordinated multi-user-agent bursts, conservative periodic rotating-client patterns, internally inconsistent browser identities, known scanner user agents, and the documented Palo Alto URL-scanner network are classified as suspected automation.
The periodic rotating-client rule requires at least 8 no-referrer requests across at least 6 landing pages and 6 trusted client addresses, with at least 80% of intervals between 4 and 25 minutes.
Malformed campaign values are audited and excluded from attributed-visit totals.
The latest attributed requests without a referrer remain visitor-type-unverified; they do not prove people, search clicks, AI referrals, citations, or recommendations.
The latest request with a verified offsite referrer came from GitHub Pages, not an AI referrer.

evidenceBoundary: This provider-maintained status records observed evidence and explicit non-results. It is not an independent audit, proof of platform indexing, proof of AI citation, or proof of recommendation. A higher level must not be inferred from a lower level.
